correctness.rationale: Exact spline tridiagonal system has explicit Green recurrence M_i=6(-a)^i(1-q^(N-i))/(1-q^N). The first-cell derivative stays positive because 2a<1; later cells have one signed cubic excursion with unique internal stationary maximum, yielding the finite formula. Three asymptotic regimes follow by geometric domination and a uniform Lipschitz bound for F. An independent standard-library tridiagonal solver and derivative-root variation calculation agrees with the closed formula on 120 numerical cases; subcritical, critical and supercritical limits checked. Computation supports, rather than substitutes for, the proof.

value.rationale: A fixed local adjacent mesh-growth ratio separating bounded, linear and exponential total variation of a globally smooth natural cubic interpolant is a structural interpolation-stability boundary. It is mathematically motivated by nonuniform mesh instability and spline overshoot and supplies exact finite-grid and sharp asymptotic laws, not an arbitrary fixed-size example. The explicit recurrence explains the instability mechanism, with a simple monotone one-jump input.
